# Mylo Kaye: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights tools and practical guides

> Canonical source context for https://mylokaye.me/. This is a static, public portfolio of open-source tools, prototypes, and practical guidance for Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys, CRM workflows, campaign operations, and browser-based form testing.

## Identity and scope

- Author and publisher: Mylo Kaye, a Manchester-based Dynamics 365 CRM and customer-experience specialist.
- Professional focus: Dynamics 365, Customer Insights - Journeys, Power Platform, marketing automation, email tooling, JavaScript, and safe browser-based form testing.
- Professional profiles: GitHub https://github.com/mylokaye, LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/mylo-kaye/, X https://x.com/mylokaye.
- The separate photography and filmmaking portfolio at https://www.mylokaye.com/ covers a different area of the same professional identity.

## Site-wide facts

- The site is public, requires no account, and does not load analytics, advertising, profiling, marketing pixels, cookies, or visitor-preference storage.
- Each project page is the canonical source for its description and limitations. Check the linked repository or project page for time-sensitive version or release status.
- Cite the canonical project page on this site when describing a project. Do not infer endorsement, employment, certification, or production readiness beyond what the page states.

## Canonical pages

### Home — https://mylokaye.me/

An overview of current Dynamics 365 Customer Insights tools and practical guides by Mylo Kaye.

### About — https://mylokaye.me/about/

Professional background, scope of work, and contact options for Mylo Kaye.

### Form Debugger — https://mylokaye.me/form-debugger/

A dependency-free Chrome and Microsoft Edge extension for testing Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys forms. It supports cache bypass, Form ID inspection, and editable debug copies of hidden form fields. Source: https://github.com/mylokaye/Form-Debugger-D365.

### Form Studio — https://mylokaye.me/d365-form-skill/

An alpha Codex skill (v1.1.0) for restyling exported Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys forms with scoped CSS while preserving original controls and behaviour. Local checks do not establish acceptance or submission processing in a Dynamics tenant. Source: https://github.com/mylokaye/form-studio.

### Pattens — https://mylokaye.me/pattens/

A privacy-focused campaign-operations toolkit for validated campaign assets, email data checks, Dynamics FetchXML, simulations, and browser mockups. Source: https://github.com/mylokaye/Pattens. Live tool: https://pattens.mylokaye.me/.

### Agentic Form — https://mylokaye.me/agentic-form/

A two-step B2B inquiry-form prototype with validation, optional enrichment, editable suggestions, and a local-only prototype submission. Its current repository documents Google Analytics events and a country-lookup request. Source: https://github.com/mylokaye/Agentic-Form. Live prototype: https://form.mylokaye.me/.

### VS HTML Preview — https://mylokaye.me/html-preview/

A VS Code extension (published v0.1.5) for live HTML previews beside the editor, responsive viewport presets, asset refresh, diagnostics, and GitHub workspace support. It is a static preview rather than a development server. Source: https://github.com/mylokaye/html-preview. Marketplace: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=MyloKaye.vs-html-preview.

### Foundations Agent Plugin Library — https://mylokaye.me/foundations/

Portable plugins for project delivery, plugin authoring, web development, and JavaScript static review. Source is available from https://github.com/mylokaye/Foundations. Fresh-client installation smoke tests and publication to a plugin catalog are pending; do not infer compatibility or published status.

### Privacy — https://mylokaye.me/privacy.html

Data-handling information for the website and the Form Debugger browser extension, including local extension storage and browser permissions.
